mapper.select: SELECT student_id AS studentId, name, kana_name AS kanaName, nickname, email, area, age, gender, remark, is_deleted AS deleted FROM students WHERE is_deleted = false
SELECT student_id AS studentId, name, kana_name AS kanaName, nickname, email, area, age, gender, remark, is_deleted AS deleted FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (name, kana_name, nickname, email, area, age, gender, remark, is_deleted) VALUES (#{name}, #{kanaName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{area}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, #{deleted})
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{name}, kana_name = #{kanaName}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, area = #{area}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{deleted} WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT course_id AS courseId, student_id AS studentId, course_name AS courseName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM student_course
SELECT course_id AS courseId, student_id AS studentId, course_name AS courseName, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM student_course WHERE student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_course (student_id, course_name, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})

MERGE INTO application_status AS aps USING (VALUES (#{courseId}, #{status})) AS vals(course_id, status) ON aps.course_id = vals.course_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET aps.status = vals.status WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (course_id, status) VALUES (vals.course_id, vals.status)
mapper.select: SELECT sc.course_id AS courseId, sc.course_name AS courseName, aps.status AS applicationStatus FROM student_course sc LEFT JOIN application_status aps ON sc.course_id = aps.course_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId}
